prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1369; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented for evaluation of neck pain and stiffness following a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Symptoms began shortly after the event and are consistent in location and character with the mechanism of injury described. Two office visits were completed. On examination, there was reduced range of motion of the cervical spine and tenderness over the paraspinal muscles, findings that support a soft tissue strain. Neurological screening, including reflexes, strength, and sensation in both upper extremities, was within normal limits. The patient reports a remote history of a minor strain in the same region, which resolved completely with no lasting limitation. Treatment consisted of conservative care, including home stretching, activity modification, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication, and followed the expected course for this type of injury. Symptoms improved steadily, and no further follow-up was needed at the time of discharge from care. Billing records reflect single charges for each visit with no duplicate entries.
